integrity: Mathematical proof with independently executable finite checks; no independent mathematical audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite commutative local rings only; graph has zero and identity vertices. Finite verification is corroboration, not an infinite proof. Earlier work covers single-idempotent counts and finite-field pair counts. Higher-dimensional graph isomorphisms are not asserted; exhaustive literature priority is not established.
title: Clique-polynomial universality for commuting idempotents over finite local rings
